name: wakeflow
description: A disciplined control loop for multi-window agent work across a fleet of Codex threads: a Controller window claims requirement packages, plans task packages, prepares deliveries, imports immutable target results, obtains independent Test validation and reviews the evidence before completing and archiving a Demand. Explicit on-disk state roots keep every step auditable; Agents perform the host actions, Wakeflow owns the content and the verification.

interface.shortDescription: Dual-host control loops for agent work
interface.longDescription: Wakeflow ships Codex and Claude Code editions of the same local-first control model. This Codex edition packages the controller state roots, requirement board, Demand event stream, task packages, delivery envelopes with hook-observed landing evidence, immutable target results, review decisions, managed evidence, pods with worktree execution, status and verify projections, and the Controller, Design, Target and Test skills for Codex workspaces. It never sends prompts or performs host actions by itself.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this directory as a Wakeflow controller workspace
Claim the next requirement package and create a Demand
